name: Elderberry 2:1 CBN + Indica Enhanced Gummies
description:
The sedating effects of CBN in combination with THC alongside terpenes found in Indica strains may provide greater sedation than THC alone. This combination may be particularly useful when preparing for sleep. It’s a little like watching sheep count you. Enjoy!

100mg THC:50mg CBN per container, 10mg THC:5mg CBN per gummy.
